cause: The native-share control forces the live status beyond its fixed wrapper at 320 px / 200% text. The original image mask correctly excludes the wrapper, exposing the protruding UI.
change: Constrain the actual status/copy/share children to their wrapper and allow controls to wrap; preserve fonts, labels, min-heights, handlers and snapshot renderer.

assertions: Native share and copy parent/viewport containment
Keyboard focus and pointer hit targets
Real share-control activation reaches a no-send stub and clears the note

limitations: This focused diagnostic and local test do not replace the final D3 recorder, required reviews or exact full green push CI.
